mapper.select:
select t.* from(
select n.*, row_number() over() as rownum from (
SELECT T4.YIELD INVEST_RATE, T4.BASIS FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T2 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T4 ON T2.CASH_ID = T4.CASH_ID AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and t2.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02} WHERE T4.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd') and NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 WHERE T4.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE > T4.EFF_DATE AND T3.EFF_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{settleDate}, 'yyyy-MM-dd'))
UNION ALL SELECT T4.YIELD INVEST_RATE, T4.BASIS FROM FIN_CASH_INFO T2 INNER JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T4 ON T2.CASH_ID = T4.CASH_ID AND T2.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} and t2.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{CASH_TYPE_1_02} WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE T3 WHERE T4.CASH_ID = T3.CASH_ID AND T3.EFF_DATE > T4.EFF_DATE) ) n ) t where t.rownum = 1
